card.name: Liver enzyme threshold numbers before ULN
card.fires_on: The number 3 or 5 (including the 5 in 1.5 or 2.5) right after 'ALT' or 'AST' and a greater-than sign. It appears in liver-enzyme dose-modification rules, just before 'x ULN' or 'times ULN'.

modes.label: Whole number 3
modes.description: The digit 3 after ALT or AST and '>' as the multiple of the upper limit of normal.
modes.example: ALT or AST ><<3>> times ULN but ≤10 times

modes.label: Decimal 1.5 or 2.5
modes.description: The 5 in a decimal threshold such as 1.5 or 2.5 before × ULN.
modes.example: Either AST or ALT is >2.<<5>> x ULN Delay further DECNUP

card.plain: It marks the number in liver-test cutoffs, such as ALT above 3 times the upper limit of normal.
